assembled_text: Edit the reference image (job a977376b). Keep the man exactly as he is: same face, age, skin texture, eyebrow scar, salt-and-pepper temples, expression, head angle, framing, golden back-right rim light, haze, shallow depth of field, film grain, and the mound-with-scaffolding background. Change ONLY his clothing and cap, to this: ONE long-sleeved outer jacket-robe in the same muted grey-blue silk, sleeves long and moderately wide reaching the wrist, with a STRAIGHT collar crossed SHALLOWLY right over left so only a thin line of the ivory under-jacket shows at the neck - no deep V, no open chest, no short-sleeved layer over long sleeves. No contrasting edging bands. Belt at the bottom edge: a leather belt with a row of small SILVER plaques and at most three short pendant drops - not gold, not bronze. Cap: a LOW birch-bark cap with a blunt rounded top, covered in plain pale silk, sitting close to the head - not a tall pointed cone. Colours grey-blue and ivory only, never purple or crimson. Exactly ONE person. No text, no watermark, no logo.
